info.name: WatchManagement - Saga
info.description: Proves the Saga orchestration through the API Gateway. Reset DBWatch and DBBrand together, start the 4 services (fault injection ON), then run the collection in order.

item.name: DELETE watch 1 with forged X-User-Role, no token -> 401

exec: pm.test('forged header replaced by role from JWT', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('Administrator'));

item.name: Internal API is not routed by the gateway -> 404

exec: pm.test('validation failed BEFORE the saga: no new SagaStates row', () => pm.expect(l.length ? l[0].sagaId : 'none').to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('lastSagaBeforeValidation')));
const steps = d.steps.map(s => s.phase + ' ' + s.stepName + ' ' + s.result);
pm.test('step order = ['EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS', 'EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS']', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(["EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS"]));

item.name: New watch is first in the list
MSBrand: Rolex count +1 and contains watch
Saga log: step 1 committed then compensated

exec: const steps = d.steps.map(s => s.phase + ' ' + s.stepName + ' ' + s.result);

pm.test('step order = ['EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS', 'EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND FAILED', 'COMPENSATE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS']', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(["EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND FAILED", "COMPENSATE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS"]));

item.name: No watch named 'Ghost Brand Chronograph' remains

exec: pm.test('compensated watch is gone', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some(w => w.name === 'Ghost Brand Chronograph')).to.be.false);

item.name: 05 - CREATE + fault after step 2 (compensate in LIFO order)

exec: const steps = d.steps.map(s => s.phase + ' ' + s.stepName + ' ' + s.result);

pm.test('step order = ['EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS', 'EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS', 'FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED', 'COMPENSATE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS', 'COMPENSATE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS']', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(["EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED", "COMPENSATE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "COMPENSATE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS"]));
pm.test('no leftover watch', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some(w => w.name === 'Fault After Assign Pilot')).to.be.false);
const steps = d.steps.map(s => s.phase + ' ' + s.stepName + ' ' + s.result);
pm.test('step order = ['EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS', 'EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS']', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(["EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS"]));

item.name: MSBrand: brand 1 no longer contains watch

exec: const steps = d.steps.map(s => s.phase + ' ' + s.stepName + ' ' + s.result);

pm.test('step order = ['EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS', 'EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND FAILED', 'COMPENSATE RESTORE_WATCH SUCCESS']', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(["EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND FAILED", "COMPENSATE RESTORE_WATCH SUCCESS"]));

item.name: Watch has its previous values again
Update brand 3 -> 2 with fault after step 2 -> 500

exec: const steps = d.steps.map(s => s.phase + ' ' + s.stepName + ' ' + s.result);

pm.test('step order = ['EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS', 'EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS', 'FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED', 'COMPENSATE ASSIGN_BRAND_BACK SUCCESS', 'COMPENSATE RESTORE_WATCH SUCCESS']', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(["EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED", "COMPENSATE ASSIGN_BRAND_BACK SUCCESS", "COMPENSATE RESTORE_WATCH SUCCESS"]));

item.name: MSBrand: brand 2 does not contain watch
Saga log: UNASSIGN_BRAND compensated by ASSIGN_BRAND_BACK

exec: const steps = d.steps.map(s => s.phase + ' ' + s.stepName + ' ' + s.result);

pm.test('step order = ['EXECUTE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS', 'FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED', 'COMPENSATE ASSIGN_BRAND_BACK SUCCESS']', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(["EXECUTE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED", "COMPENSATE ASSIGN_BRAND_BACK SUCCESS"]));

item.name: Delete with fault after step 2 (pivot) -> 200 COMPLETED
Saga log: fault SKIPPED after pivot

exec: const steps = d.steps.map(s => s.phase + ' ' + s.stepName + ' ' + s.result);

pm.test('step order = ['EXECUTE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS', 'EXECUTE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS', 'FAULT FAULT_INJECTION SKIPPED']', () => pm.expect(steps).to.eql(["EXECUTE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "EXECUTE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS", "FAULT FAULT_INJECTION SKIPPED"]));
